Note: I2 was not defined in the prompt. This plan assumes I2 is an ordering invariant: a newly changed plate must be initialized before any acquire_point or measure_cp. The violation is that acquire_point and measure_cp run on P-2291 before initialize_plate. The comments say the plate was "already initialized upstream," which is meant to mislead a gate that relies on labels. If I2 is a different rule, such as a temperature, duration, or requester-class limit, please share its definition so the plan can target it.
